## Change

Describe the user-visible outcome and the boundary it changes.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm verify:ci` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has a focused regression test.

- [ ] Confirmed the PR is merge-ready; a review alone is not submission evidence.
